SNIPCART_PUBLIC_API_KEY.description: Snipcart calls it the public API key and has you paste it into a script tag on every storefront page, which is as plain as this gets. The variable name is convention.

SNIPCART_SECRET_API_KEY.description: Snipcart says anyone holding a secret key can reach all of your account information, and that keys must never appear in source code or in compiled front-end assets.
